findings.evidence: ElementaryTwoQuotient.lean:197-200 proves `elementaryTwoQuotientMap_mk` by `rfl`; `MonoidHom.fst G H p` is defeq `p.1`.
findings.fix: Replace the `change`+`simp only` body with `rfl` (or, if `simp` is preferred for stability, add a comment stating the `change` unfolds the equiv's `toFun` across the `≃ₗ` coercion).
findings.issue: `elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv_mk` opens with an undocumented `change` restating the goal via the bundled `toFun`. Since `elementaryTwoQuotientMap_mk` is `rfl` and `MonoidHom.fst/snd` reduce definitionally, the whole lemma is `rfl`.

findings.evidence: `toFun x i := elementaryTwoQuotientMap (Pi.evalMonoidHom G i) x` (line 142) and `elementaryTwoQuotientMap_mk` is `rfl`; `Pi.evalMonoidHom G i g` is defeq `g i`.
findings.fix: Reduce to `funext i; rfl`, or document why the `change` is needed.
findings.issue: `elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv_mk` uses an undocumented `change` then `rw [elementaryTwoQuotientMap_mk]; rfl`; the goal after `funext i` is definitional.

findings.evidence: Line 157-159: `change ... rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single j]`; the rubric flags any `change`/`show` lacking a justifying comment.
findings.fix: Add a one-line comment noting the `change` beta-reduces the bundled `toFun`/`invFun` so `map_sum` can fire, or replace with `simp only []`/`beta_reduce` to expose the sum.
findings.issue: The `right_inv` field of `elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv` uses an undocumented `change` to beta-reduce the `toFun (invFun p) j` goal before `rw [map_sum]`.

summary: Proofs are otherwise robust (explicit `simp only` sets, factored helper lemmas), but three `change` steps are used without the comment the rubric requires; two of them are unnecessary because the goal is definitional.
